notes:
Lead profile: SMB (support SaaS) — building an in-app chat + ticket summarization feature. Wants self-serve hosted API; low setup friction.

Key constraints / asks: 
- Latency SLO: 95th < 500ms for chat replies (short context, 256 tokens typical)
- Throughput: initial burst ~5 req/s, expected steady-state 1-2 req/s
- Cost sensitivity: evaluating per-month spend, wants to keep production costs under $2k/month initially
- Quality: wants human-like summaries for internal agents; will trade some quality for cost on auto-summaries but not on agent-facing responses

Model selection questions from customer (verbatim/paraphrase):
- "Is Llama-2-13B a good baseline vs Mistral-Instruct-7B for chat?"
- "We saw Qwen and some smaller Llama variants — how do these compare for short-turn chat + summarization?"
- "What's the quantized performance difference (latency/cost) if we choose 4-bit vs 8-bit?"
- "Can we do routing: high-quality model for live agent assist, cheaper model for nightly batch summaries?"

Redwood recommended approach (initial guidance given):
- Start with Mistral-Instruct-7B hosted for pilot: good quality/cost balance for short responses, lower token cost than 13B Llama in many cases.
- Run a side-by-side eval of Llama-2-13B (higher quality on some subjective tasks) — include prompt tuning and temperature sweeps.
- Quantization: propose 4-bit for inference to reduce cost; include quality guardrail evals on 50 prompt sets.
- Routing plan: use model routing policy (hosted) — agent-facing route -> Llama-2-13B, auto-summaries batch -> Mistral-7B cheaper variant; fallback to small instruct model on quota.

POC asks / success criteria: 
- Baseline: 200 example conversations scored for accuracy/utility by support team
- Latency: average p50 < 200ms p95 < 500ms for agent route in us-east region
- Cost target: pilot <$2k/month, scale plan with clear per-1M-token estimates
